title: eCommerce Integrations & Platforms Partnership Manager UK & ROI
description: Develop and manage strategic relationships with eCommerce platform, integration and technology partners to support adoption of Global Payments eCommerce and card-not-present solutions across the UK and Republic of Ireland. Own day-to-day management of assigned partners, engagement models, governance and performance standards. Enable partners through structured onboarding, training, product knowledge and sales-enablement materials. Collaborate with Sales, Migrations, Enablement, Product, Professional Services. Monitor partner activity, referral quality, pipeline and performance metrics, using data and insight. Regular reporting and insight. Proven experience managing platform, integration, alliance or technology partner relationships, ideally within eCommerce, payments, SaaS. Strong understanding of eCommerce platforms, payment integrations, digital payments and card-not-present journeys. Referral-led, partner-led or channel growth models. Travel across UK and ROI.

title: Senior Programme Manager
description: Lead the delivery of a high value (>£15M per annum) complex programme involving maritime consulting and a software portfolio. Lead and motivate Project Managers within the programme. Customer, partner and supplier engagement. Deliver programme outcomes to agreed baseline (time, cost, quality). 5-8 years of leading a business, projects, programmes or P3 function; successful delivery of complex programmes; experience leading programmes to 3 different customers. MSP Practitioner desirable. Hybrid working pattern of 3 days per week on average onsite. All applicants must be eligible for SC clearance.

title: Product Manager
description: 12 month fixed term contract. Hybrid working: 50% of the working week at Southampton HQ. Manage new and existing street-related products for the Transport sector; product strategy, outcome-based roadmaps, scorecards, KPIs and customer outcomes; product leadership in cross-functional delivery teams; user engagement and research; communicate strategy and roadmap decisions to senior stakeholders. Experience managing product performance and roadmaps in a customer-focused environment; data driven decisions; stakeholder engagement. Tools: Aha!, QGIS, ArcGIS, PowerBI, Co-Pilot. Right to work in the UK required; no sponsorship. Closing date 29 November 2026.

title: Project Manager
description: Programme, Performance & Change team. Lead and deliver projects from initiation to implementation; governance, reporting, risk, dependencies, finances; embed change management, adoption and benefits realisation; stakeholder engagement. APM, PRINCE2, MSP, Prosci, APMG Change Management or equivalent valuable. Hybrid: 50% of the week at Southampton HQ. Closing 30 November 2026.
